artists.source_line: Salsa Zone and Brighton Fiesta Latinos are thrilled to announce our second International SBK Summer Festival this year!
Salsa Zone and Brighton Fiesta Latinos are thrilled to announce our second International SBK Summer Festival this year!

features.quote: Workshops run from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM
features.rationale: The schedule lists dance workshops running in the afternoon as part of the event.
The description promises performances and shows by artists at the festival.
The event has three dance rooms: a salsa, a bachata and a kizomba room.
